translation_exact: Among the stories told in Troezen about Theseus, they say that when Heracles came to Troezen as a guest of Pittheus, he laid down the lion's skin during dinner. Then some of the Troezenian children entered the room, including Theseus, who was just reaching his seventh year. All the other boys, on seeing the skin, fled in fear, but Theseus, slipping out quietly and without great fright, seized an axe from one of the attendants and quickly returned toward it, believing the lion skin to be a living lion.

fit_records.name: translation
fit_records.text:
Among the stories told in Troezen about Theseus,
they say that when Heracles came to Troezen as a
guest of Pittheus, he laid down the lion's skin
during dinner. Then some of the Troezenian
children entered the room, including Theseus, who
was just reaching his seventh year. All the other
boys, on seeing the skin, fled in fear, but Theseus,
slipping out quietly and without great fright, seized
an axe from one of the attendants and quickly
returned toward it, believing the lion skin to be a
living lion.
